oil.when: 2009 (Oil Life System reset from the Driver Information Center buttons)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the vehicle in Park, turn the ignition on.
Press and hold the INFO and Reset buttons together to open the personalization menu.
When OIL LIFE RESET shows, press and hold the Reset button for at least one second.
Wait for the ACKNOWLEDGED message, then turn the ignition off.
Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the Tire and Loading Information label on the driver's side (cold means parked at least three hours or driven under a mile).
There is no reset button. The low tire pressure light stays on until the pressure is corrected, then goes off on its own.
Pressing the DIC button only hides the CHECK TIRE PRESSURE message for now. It comes back at the next start if a tire is still low.
tpms.note: If the light comes on only on cold mornings and goes off as you drive, a tire is getting low: check and top up the pressures.
